rounds.note: Here's your Doom Knight! Big silver and black armor, a green hood and cape, black horns, glowing green eyes behind a silver mask, green flames coming off his head, and a giant axe with a green gem. The last picture shows him next to the Knight so you can see how big he is. Love it, or tap Change it and tell me what to fix!

New mask! Now it's a flat iron faceplate like Dr. Doom's: square jaw, rivets down the sides, a straight nose, narrow glowing green eye slits and a thin mouth slot. I kept his horns, flames and axe. How's that?
Round 3! The hood now comes forward over the top of his mask and down the sides like a real hood, he's slimmer, and his axe is on fire with green flames. How's that?
Round 4: I pushed the mask back into his face so it doesn't stick out any more. Everything else stays the same. Try 🎨 Tweak it yourself too, to change his colors or size!
